key_insight: A frozen multimodal model can keep improving after deployment by learning from prior cases through external skill, knowledge, and visual memory rather than retraining its weights.
clinical_relevance: This could help medical AI stay aligned with evolving evidence and workflows while preserving performance across new cases and tasks.
method: Skill: an external guide for reasoning and tool use.
Knowledge Memory: stores reliable facts from past cases and trusted evidence.
Multimodal Knowledge Base: retains visual examples and links retrieved cases to the current image.
evidence_signal: Evaluated across six benchmarks with four open-weight and closed-source base models, showing up to 34.2% improvement over the base model on medical tasks during online deployment.
watch_item: Because updates depend on retrieval and validation logic, real-world performance may vary if the stored cases, evidence quality, or memory selection are noisy or outdated.
paper_title: Frozen Models, Evolving Expertise: Model-Agnostic Learning from Deployment Experience for Multimodal Medical AI
